mauricio_gomes_seminar.title: 2025 Mauricio Gomes Seminar
mauricio_gomes_seminar.notes: Source date 6 Dec 2025 looks past relative to Sep 2026; date preserved from source.
mauricio_gomes_seminar.html:
A seminar hosted by Kingston Jiu Jitsu with Mauricio Gomes — 8th-degree coral belt and one of the pioneers of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu in Europe.

Seminar details

  • Date: 6 December 2025
  • Time: 2.00–4.00 pm
  • Location: Tiffin Sports Centre, London Rd, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 6RL
  • Price: £30 for members, £40 for non-members

About Mauricio

Mauricio began training in jiu-jitsu at four years of age. His father, a brown belt, took him to classes at João Alberto Barreto’s academy.

As a teenager he trained with Rolls Gracie, won the absolute division of the Rio de Janeiro State Championships in 1981, and was awarded his black belt by Rolls shortly afterwards. He continued training with Rolls until Rolls’ death in 1982.

Through his ties with the Gracie family he met Reila Gracie, daughter of Carlos Gracie Sr. They had a son, Roger Gracie, a ten-time World Champion.

In the late 1990s Mauricio came to the UK and established the first Gracie Barra gym here. Through his teaching, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu grew across the country.

4-week-womens-beginners-course.title: 4-Week Women's Beginners Course
4-week-womens-beginners-course.notes: Source start date 6 Jan 2026 looks past relative to Sep 2026; date preserved from source.
4-week-womens-beginners-course.html:
A 4-week women’s-only beginners course in a friendly, supportive environment. No uniform needed and no experience required — bring comfortable gym clothes.

You’ll learn the fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu in a women-only setting, building confidence, fitness and practical self-defence skills.

Course details

  • Location: Tiffin Sports Centre, Kingston
  • Starts: Tuesday, 6 January 2026
  • Time: Every Tuesday, 7–8 pm
  • Price: £40 for the full 4 weeks

What’s included

  • Core jiu jitsu positions and movements
  • How to stay safe and comfortable on the ground
  • Simple escapes and control techniques
  • Practical self-defence concepts
  • How to train safely

Spaces are limited. Questions: admin@kingstonjiujitsu.com.

What’s included

  • Free BJJ gi and white belt
  • Practical self-defence skills

6-week-no-gi-beginners-course.title: 6-Week No-Gi Beginners Course
6-week-no-gi-beginners-course.notes: Source start 'Thursday, 1st May' has no year and looks past relative to Sep 2026; date preserved from source.
6-week-no-gi-beginners-course.html:
A 6-week beginners course for No-Gi Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. Suitable if you’re new to grappling, usually train in the gi, or want a clear reset on the fundamentals.

Course details

  • Location: Tiffin Sports Centre, Kingston
  • Starts: Thursday, 1 May
  • Time: Every Thursday, 8–9 pm
  • Price: £50 for the entire course

What’s included

  • No-Gi specific fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu
  • How to control and escape from key ground positions
  • Distance management and takedowns suited to No-Gi
  • Basic submissions and escapes
  • Essential movement and strategy without relying on the gi

Spaces are limited. Contact admin@kingstonjiujitsu.com with any questions.

kingston-jiu-jitsu-x-mauricio-gomes-limi.title: Kingston Jiu Jitsu × Mauricio Gomes Limited Edition Gi | Black
kingston-jiu-jitsu-x-mauricio-gomes-limi.notes: Tidied promotional sections; preserved features and size guide facts.
kingston-jiu-jitsu-x-mauricio-gomes-limi.html:
A special collaboration celebrating the roots of Kingston Jiu Jitsu and the legacy of Professor Mauricio Gomes.

This limited edition gi features a custom inner lining with sublimated artwork of Kingston Bridge at sunset. The illustration was created by artist Mark Stroud and captures one of the most recognisable landmarks in Kingston upon Thames — the place where our academy and community have grown.

Once these are gone, they will not be reproduced.

Key features

  • Limited edition collaboration with Mauricio Gomes
  • Custom sublimated lining featuring Kingston Bridge artwork by Mark Stroud
  • Exclusive Kingston Jiu Jitsu design
  • Lightweight pearl weave jacket for durability and comfort
  • Reinforced stitching in all key stress areas
  • Competition-legal construction
  • Unique woven Kingston Jiu Jitsu detailing
